runtimeChecks.description: envelope has exactly analysisInputVersion, source, operations
source is an object with exactly kind and description
source.kind is a non-blank string
source.description is a non-blank string
operations (or a bare array) is a nonempty list
every operation is an object
record has exactly the nine AIM fields
aimVersion is 0.2.0-draft
instanceId is a non-blank string
attemptId is a non-blank string
definition has exactly id and digest
definition.id is a non-blank string
definition.digest matches sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
inputDigest matches sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
dependencies items are nonempty strings
dependencies are unique
readVersions keys are non-blank strings
readVersions values are Python ints >= 0 (JSON 1.0 is a float)
effects has exactly four members
each effect has exactly kind and resource
effect kind is one of eight kinds
effect resource is a non-blank string
coverage has exactly status, domain, method
coverage status is complete, partial or unknown
coverage domain is non-blank
coverage method is non-blank
evidence is a nonempty list (items are not inspected)
instanceId values are unique in a batch
attemptId values are unique in a batch
dependencies name instances of the batch
no instance depends on itself
dependencies are acyclic
at most 32 operations (array, or 'operations'/'tasks' list of an object)
instanceId and attemptId at most 256 UTF-8 bytes (array items and 'operations' items only)
nesting depth at most 32
request at most 1 MiB
git request has exactly the four fields
git request version is 0.1.0-alpha
repository is a non-blank string
repository equals the configured source root
operations is a list with at least two items
operation has exactly the five fields
instanceId and attemptId are non-blank strings
dependencies items are nonempty strings (uniqueness is not checked)
uncertainPaths items are nonempty strings (uniqueness is not checked)
source has exactly kind+revision (commit) or kind+path (worktree)
source kind is commit or worktree
baseRevision and source revisions are non-blank and resolve to a commit

rootCauses.rootCause: RC-adapter-bypass: the 256-byte identifier bound is not applied to a single AIM record request
RC-adapter: adapter bounds (32 operations, 256-byte identifiers) are not in any schema
RC-batch: batch-level checks (duplicates, unknown or self dependency, cycles) that JSON Schema cannot express
RC-blank: the runtime refuses blank strings; the schema states minLength only
RC-envelope: no published schema for the analysis-input envelope
RC-evidence: runtime checks only that evidence is a nonempty array; the schema validates each item
RC-git-resolution: a value that is not blank for Python strip() but does not resolve to a repository or revision
RC-git-unique: the git adapter does not enforce uniqueItems on dependencies and uncertainPaths
RC-pattern-newline: the Python jsonschema `$` accepts a trailing newline (ECMAScript does not); the runtime fullmatch refuses it
RC-readversions: readVersions key and number semantics differ

summary.thresholdNote: Counted per root cause, not per probe: one cause (for example the runtime ignoring evidence items) yields many probes. Per-probe and per-keyword counts are in the rows.

whitespaceSemantics.note: A schema pattern for 'not blank' would use ECMAScript \s, which differs from Python on these characters; corpus strings avoid them (REQ-004).
